correctness.rationale: The actual Finding is correct for the fixed smooth plane model and p >= 5, p != 7. Independently reconstructed the Hessian, verified both equations at the four coordinate representatives modulo Phi_7, formed the minimal polynomials by orbit products, and recomputed the separation discriminants and cross-resultants. The nonzero affine eliminant excludes common components (the line at infinity is not a component); the 22 distinct affine projections and two infinity points exhaust the degree-24 intersection, with every local length one. In these characteristics the Hessian detects tangent contact m=3 or 4 with local order m-2: in local tangent coordinates it is a unit times the second derivative of the local graph, and m(m-1) is invertible. Thus all 24 flexes are ordinary. Three fixed vertices, a three-element orbit with stabilizer {+1,-1}, and three regular sextic orbits give all rows, extension counts and zeta factors, and the last three orbits force the stated exact splitting fields. Minor sign error in the proof/certificate, not in the Finding: with the standard convention Res_y(f,h)=Norm(h mod f) for monic f, the resultant is +xABCD, not -xABCD. The Sylvester determinant at x=1 is -232, whereas SymPy 1.14.0 resultant reports +232. The proof uses the eliminant only up to a unit. Reproduction: python /workspace/flex_and_octic_reproduction.py (SymPy 1.14.0); frozen VERIFY.py inspected, not executed.
